verdict.rationale: Klaviyo's docs list Klaviyo-maintained server-side SDKs for Python, PHP, Ruby and Node, plus mobile SDKs for iOS, Android, React Native and Flutter. These are backed by documented auth, rate-limit headers and a Postman collection, so the core of the story is clearly delivered. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality and maintenance, SDK-specific depth (reference docs, versioning, typed clients), and AI-native affordances such as llms.txt (the probe returned 404).
